regime_context: Detector shows a narrow leadership cluster (Gold Miners, Industrial Metals) with no single dominant narrative. Momentum ranks are display-only (rank-IC ~0). The absolute trend gate historically did not reduce drawdown in this market (mean-reverting), and the desk's prior calls have low accuracy (hit rate 0.41, direction 0.32). Any leans are low-conviction and strictly conditional.
emerging_watch: Watch for the narrative score of Industrial Metals to cross above Gold Miners and hold for 5 consecutive trading days. The current margin is only 0.018, so a confirmed handoff would warrant re-evaluating the leadership structure.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is a high-qual trend candidate: durability bar 0.87, breadth 0.923, not crowded, and eligible on the absolute trend gate. The rotation radar places it as the closest challenger to Gold Miners (margin 0.018). Overweight aligns with trend-following discipline, though the gate has whipsawed in this market's history and conviction must be low.
theses.dissent: Industrial metals are highly sensitive to China's macroeconomic cycle; any slowdown could reverse the trend, and the narrow lead over Gold Miners may not hold.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags CSI 300 by 3% over any 10-day period before the horizon date.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma ranks 4th with decent durability (0.82) and full breadth (1.0), but its crowding z-score of 1.61 triggers the detector's size-down caution. Per guardrails, crowding does not justify a fade, only a cap on exposure. We avoid adding new weight to this theme.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution, never a sell or short
theses.dissent: If the theme continues its trend with strong breadth, avoidance will miss further gains and the crowding flag may prove a false positive.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 by more than 2% over any 10-day window before the horizon date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
